description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a data model and a route for updating items via PUT request.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item's data with fields for name, description, price, and tax.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, q: str | None = None)
